infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: PrimaLux Care reads steps, heart rate, and sleep on this iPhone after you allow it. Readings stay on this device unless you choose to share a daily summary.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: PrimaLux Care can save a pulse reading you type. It does not change other Apple Health data.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: PrimaLux Care uses the camera to read a medication label on this iPhone. The photo is not saved and is not sent.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: PrimaLux Care can read a photo of a medication label that you choose. The photo is not saved and is not sent.
